# Thrive Labs

> Thrive Labs is an AI agents and automation studio based in Vancouver, BC. We build custom AI agents that teams actually use, and cinematic websites for local businesses.

## Services

- Custom AI agents for ops, sales, and support — built on tools like ElevenLabs and Retell for voice, plus custom workflow and orchestration pipelines.
- Workflow automation — replacing manual, repetitive processes with agents that run reliably in production.
- Cinematic websites for local businesses — high-craft, motion-driven sites (canvas hero animations, AI-generated visuals) built for restaurants, med spas, salons, and boutique hospitality brands.

## About

Thrive Labs ships production systems, not prototypes — live in weeks, not quarters. Pocket Director AI (pocketdirectorai.com) is a Thrive Labs product built and run end-to-end by the same team, used as proof of the standard we hold client work to.

## Contact
